item.title: Anthropic releases Claude Duet, a consumer‑friendly AI work assistant
item.description:
Anthropic releases Claude Duet, a consumer‑friendly AI work assistant

Claude Duet is Anthropic’s newest AI agent aimed at consumers who want help with work without writing code. The author tested it for a week while juggling a busy travel and work schedule.

🔍 Overview

  • Claude Duet is positioned as a consumer‑friendly, work‑focused AI agent.
  • It follows earlier Anthropic agents: Claude Code (a coding agent) → Claude Cowork (more consumer‑friendly) → Claude Duet (most consumer‑friendly and work‑oriented).
  • Other recent agents mentioned in the landscape are Instinct’s text‑based assistant, Meta’s Muse, and OpenAI’s Dots.

⚙️ How it works

  • Users connect productivity and chat services (email, calendar, Google Docs, Slack). Duet then scans the data and surfaces suggestions as swipeable cards, similar to a “to‑do list Tinder.”
  • Each morning Duet greets the user, highlights key items (e.g., packing for a video shoot), and proposes to‑dos with offers to draft messages or add agenda items.
  • By accessing a biweekly staff‑meeting summary email and Slack, Duet linked a meeting comment to a direct Slack message.
  • Access to a shared Google Doc let Duet identify the user’s manager for weekly 1:1 meetings.

📋 Key Details

  • Design – Cheery, minimalist Claude design; app described as consumer‑friendly and approachable.
  • Platform – Available as a standalone app, now fully supports the iPhone Duo.
  • Interaction style – Swipe left/right on suggestion cards; drafted messages are tagged “sent with Claude.”
  • Personalization – Mirrors the user’s writing habits (e.g., all‑lowercase style) and occasionally adds playful asides.
  • Data usage – Operates on data the user opts‑in to share; Anthropic notes ongoing testing of its judgment about when to message.

🚀 Availability

  • Claude Duet is a “research preview.”
  • Access limited to Pro, Max, and Ultra subscribers in the United States, with a waitlist for additional users.
  • Intended for “professionals and small business owners,” not for casual tasks like ordering food.

💡 Why it matters

  • Compared to Meta’s Muse and OpenAI’s Dots, Duet is described as “even more focused on work.”
  • It pushes the idea that AI agents can be useful for non‑programmers by handling everyday professional workflows.
  • The swipe‑card interface and daily brief aim to make AI assistance feel like a natural extension of existing productivity tools.

📊 Comparison to other agents

Agent Primary focus
Claude Duet Consumer‑friendly work assistance
Claude Cowork More consumer‑friendly than Claude Code
Claude Code Coding assistance
Instinct Text‑based assistant
Meta Muse Help with buying things
OpenAI Dots Work‑oriented assistant

#Anthropic #ClaudeDuet #AIagents #Productivity

Source: Claude’s Duet agent is a little neurotic and surprisingly helpful

item.title: Anthropic releases Claude Duet AI agent for professionals and small businesses
item.description:
Anthropic releases Claude Duet AI agent for professionals and small businesses

Anthropic announced Claude Duet, a new AI agent aimed at professionals and small business owners.

🔍 Overview

  • Claude Duet is Anthropic’s new AI agent for professionals and small business owners, launching as a research preview.
  • Competes with Meta’s Muse and OpenAI’s Dots.
  • Built around Claude Opus 5.5.

🧩 How it works

  • Pulls in memory, skills, and connected apps from Claude.
  • Includes a virtual machine with a browser for completing work.
  • Sends a short brief each morning with the most important items across connected apps.
  • Monitors apps and messages throughout the day, notifying only when something needs attention.
  • Can handle tasks ranging from simple scheduling to building dashboards, creating financial or sales forecasts, prototyping, and building web apps.
  • Before any big step like sending a payment or deleting something, Claude Duet messages you for approval.
  • Uses a new dedicated classifier and safety system prompt designed to reject requests to share the strictest tier of information, such as credit card numbers.

⚙️ Key details

  • Anthropic says Claude Duet is an early version and may misread a thread or miscalibrate what’s urgent.
  • It is not as strong at personal errands like booking tickets.
  • Available as a standalone app on iOS and Android and through Claude on the web.
  • Access requires joining a waitlist and being a Pro or Max subscriber in the US.

🚀 Availability

  • Launched as a research preview.
  • Waitlist required; limited to Pro or Max subscribers in the United States.

💡 Why it matters

  • Provides an AI‑driven assistant tailored for professional workflows.
  • Combines memory, app integration, and a browser VM into a single agent.
  • Introduces safety mechanisms for handling sensitive information.

#Anthropic #ClaudeDuet #AIagents #Productivity

Source: Anthropic takes on Muse with Claude Duet, its new AI agent
